A.title: Eyes + posture reset
A.subtitle: 30–45 seconds  ·  every 20 minutes
steps: Look about 20 feet / 6 m away for 20 seconds — soft gaze
Blink fully 10 times — close completely, open soft
Chin tuck (gentle double-chin) and drop your shoulders
Five slow shoulder-blade squeezes — pinch, then release

B.title: Stand + stretch
B.subtitle: 90–120 seconds  ·  every 40 minutes  ·  stand up
steps: Neck: side bend and gentle rotation, both sides (~15s each)
Chest opener: hands clasped behind back or doorway (20s)
Thoracic: reach up and lean slightly — mid-back (15s)
Standing hip flexor stretch, both sides (15s each)
Wrists: prayer + reverse prayer, or finger fans (15s)

C.title: Bands or walk
C.subtitle: 3–5 minutes  ·  every 90 minutes
steps: Band pull-aparts ×12 — arms long, squeeze blades
Band face pulls ×10 — elbows high, external rotation
Band rows ×10 — quiet ribs, squeeze mid-back
Band good-mornings or glute bridges ×10
Optional: standing band hip abductions ×8 / side

bands.title: Resistance band mini-circuit
bands.subtitle: 3–5 minutes  ·  every 90 minutes
steps: Band pull-aparts ×12 — arms long, squeeze blades
Band face pulls ×10 — elbows high, external rotation
Band rows ×10 — quiet ribs, squeeze mid-back
Band good-mornings or glute bridges ×10
Optional: standing band hip abductions ×8 / side

walk.title: Walk break
walk.subtitle: 3–5 minutes  ·  every 90 minutes
steps: Leave the desk completely
Walk 3–5 minutes (hall, stairs, outdoors if possible)
Drink water
Optional: outdoor light / look at a distant horizon
